posts.caption:
Copied is not the same as safe.

Finder copies your footage. It doesn't check it. A clip that broke on the way looks exactly like a good one, until someone opens it in the edit.

Cardpont reads every copy back from every SSD and compares it with the card. Only when everything matches do you get the green check.
